description: In the 2025-26 state budget of Rs 3.7 lakh cr presented today by Finance Minister Kanu Desai, the Gujarat government has allocated Rs 59,999 cr for the education department.
body_lead: - English News - Local - Gujarat - Gujarat Allocates Rs 59,999 Crore For Education In Budget: Pushes Focus On AI, Infra, Student Welfare; Mission 'Schools Of Excellence' Get Rs 2,914 Crore Gujarat allocates Rs 59,999 crore for education in budget:Pushes focus on AI, infra, student welfare; Mission 'Schools of Excellence' get Rs 2,914 crore - Copy link In the 2025-26 state budget of Rs 3.7 lakh crore presented today by Finance Minister Kanu Desai, the Gujarat government has allocated Rs 59,999 crore for the education department.
